MODIFY internal/store/open.go: added withBusyTimeout(dsn) which appends '?_pragma=busy_timeout(5000)' to the DSN, applied in Open before sql.Open. GROUNDING-DRIVEN DEVIATION (flag for reviewer): the delegation said 'add PRAGMA busy_timeout alongside the existing WAL pragma' (WAL is set via ExecContext). But busy_timeout is a PER-CONNECTION pragma (unlike journal_mode=WAL, which is persistent on the DB file and so reaches every pooled connection via the ExecContext). database/sql POOLS connections; a PRAGMA via db.ExecContext only affects the one connection that ran it, so concurrent writers on OTHER pool connections (scan PutItem / the API / the worker pool) would STILL hit 'database is locked' (modernc default 0). Verified against modernc.org/sqlite driver.go:49-86: _pragma DSN values are applied on EVERY connection at connect time. So the DSN mechanism is the genuine root-cause fix for pool-wide coverage; the literal ExecContext-alongside-WAL would be insufficient. Additive (1 pragma), no DDL, no schema change. Test: TestOpen/busy_timeout_set queries PRAGMA busy_timeout on an arbitrary pool connection -> 5000 (proves pool-wide, not just the migration connection). C-01 RESOLVED (QA-verified finding, qa/debug_brief.md). Root cause: decodeDoc (worker.go) unmarshals the persisted doc into map[string]any, and encoding/json decodes the _stages JSON array as []any (each element map[string]any), NOT []map[string]any.
